project_info.audience: Forex traders, EA developers/operators, Forex broker sales
project_info.core_vibe: High-end visual impact, sci-fi/tech aesthetic, trustworthy FinTech
project_info.theme_and_archetype: Dark Theme, Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) adapted for High-End FinTech (Deep Obsidian, Metallic Gold, Electric Cyan)

rules.anti_default_rule: Inter is BANNED for headings. Use Outfit for high-tech modern feel.
rules.typesetting: Tight tracking for headings, wide tracking for overlines.
rules.hierarchy: Fluid scaling up to text-6xl for Hero.

headings.usage: Hero texts, section titles, highly technical numeric displays.

body.usage: Paragraphs, long descriptions, standard UI text.

mono.usage: Data points, EA stats (profit, drawdown), code blocks, overlines.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Bento grid layouts for EA cards. High density only where data (trading stats) requires it.

grid_modes.ea_list: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris grid) - asymmetrical layout showcasing EA performance and strategies.
grid_modes.indicators: Bento Grid Mode B (Control Room) - symmetrical 3-column grid for dense visual previews.

cursor.design: Glowing cyan dot (4px) with a trailing outer ring (32px) that leaves a fading motion trail. Mix blend mode: difference.

background_particles.design: Interactive starry night sky in the hero section that subtly reacts to mouse movement.

scroll_animations.effects: Fade up and staggered reveals for grid items. Parallax floating elements (geometric tech shapes).

hover_states.cards: Subtle -translate-y-1, border color shifts to cyan-500/50, inner glow shadow.
hover_states.buttons: Background slide or scale effect, ensuring text color remains strictly readable (high contrast).

header.style: Glassmorphism (Crystal variant). bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
header.layout: Fixed top, z-50. Logo left, Nav middle, Lang Toggle & CTA right.

hero.layout: Full height (min-h-screen). Absolute positioned WebGL starry sky background. Content centered.
hero.elements: Huge typographic brand intro '无限量化', Gold/Cyan text gradients, CTA opens a modal showing QR 'img/推广连接-29.png'.

ea_card.style: Tracing Beam or Neumorphism variant adapted for dark mode. bg-white/5 border border-white/10.
ea_card.layout: Header: EA Name + Profit Badge. Body: Risk graph (Recharts) or text stats. Footer: Partnership CTA.

floating_widget.style: Fixed bottom right, z-50. Glowing neon border.
floating_widget.action: Hover/Click expands to show WeChat QR code.

seo_and_metadata.description: 提供高端外汇自动交易(EA)策略、顶级指标、CG合作平台开户及MT4/MT5技术教学。

hero_background.description: Starry night sky used as fallback or texture layer behind Three.js particles

tech_abstract.description: High-tech abstract circuit pattern for Indicators/Tutorials section background

trader_professional.description: Professional forex trader for 'About Us' or 'Join Us' section

neon_data.description: Abstract neon data lines for EA strategies section visual accents

instructions_to_main_agent: Must implement custom cursor with trail effect tracking mouse movement on desktop.
Homepage Hero MUST feature a Starry Sky particle animation. Use react-tsparticles or @react-three/fiber with Stars.
For multi-language, setup a basic React context or i18next switching between 'zh' and 'en'. Default to 'zh'.
Use standard HTML div/section with Tailwind for marketing layouts. Use Shadcn strictly for interactive elements like Accordions (CG Broker FAQ), Dropdowns (Lang Switcher), and Forms (Join Us).
Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) for backgrounds. Stick to the Dark Obsidian (#050505) palette.
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) using kebab-case role-based names.
